articles.title: Apple To Unveil HomeView Smart Home Hub Tomorrow, But It Won't Ship Until Mid-November
articles.description: Apple is expected to unveil its new HomeView smart home hub at its October 13 event in New York. The touch-enabled device is reportedly powered by an A18 chip and supports AI-based Siri. It is expected in tabletop and wall-mounted versions, with the tabletop model offering stronger audio than the HomePod mini at launch too.
